messages.author: 6e09270a0b8adccb
messages.subject: 2 - selectInputs
parts:
Hi,

I'm encountering this error in my app which I've reproduced here. Basically, I can select a column in the first selectInput box, but not the second. I don't see how it differs from the K-means app. My R session has options(shiny.error = browser) and 

function (e)
{
  if (inherits(e, "shiny.silent.error"))
    return()
  handle <- getOption("shiny.error")
  if (is.function(handle))
    handle()
}

keeps popping up in my Anonymous function tab, which may be a clue. Any suggestions?

gwynn


library(shiny)
D = matrix(runif(400), nrow = 20)
colnames(D) = c("PROTECT",                                                                 
                "SAFER Lines",                                                         
                "Name",                                                                    
                "County",                                                                  
                "For Profit",                                                              
                "Health Inspection",                                                    
                "Quality Measures",                                                     
                "Staffing",                                                                
                "2014 Census",                                                          
                "Total Admissions",                                                     
                "% Admissions w/ LOS: 100+",                                            
                "# of Days Assessed",                                                   
                "Cumulative Census",                                                    
                "% Antibacterial Usage",                                                
                "2014 Total Discharges",                                                
                "% Discharge to Hospital",                                              
                "% Discharges to Hospital w/ Infx based on Primary & Other Diagnoses",
                "Avg. Elixhauser Score",                                                
                "Any MDRO",                                                                
                "High Frequency of Bath/Shower (5+ days/wk)")

# Define UI for application that summarises data
ui <- fluidPage(
 
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Summaries"),
 
  # Select columns to get fed into summary
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Matching Variables Info",
             sidebarPanel(
               selectInput("col1", "First Column", colnames(D)),
               selectInput("col2", "Second Column", colnames(D), colnames(D)[2])
             ),
            
             # Show summaries of columns choosen above
             mainPanel(
               verbatimTextOutput("dataInfo")
             )
    )
  )
)


# Define the server code
server <- function(input, output){
 
  output$dataInfo <- renderPrint({
    summary(D[,c(input$col1, input$col2)])
  })
 
}

# Return a Shiny app object
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

parts:
I believe this is due to using the character \r , and making "SAFER\r\nLines" as the default selection.
in this case:
 input$col2=  "SAFER\nLines"

messages.subject: Re: 2 - selectInputs
parts:
You can clean it after reading. If it's always , you remove it using gsub or sth as follows:

gsub("\r(?= )","","SAFER Lines",perl = T) # if you want to keep
[1] "SAFER Lines"


gsub(" "," ","SAFER Lines") # if it's always
[1] "SAFER Lines"


# or any other expression ....
